note: San Diego County park in pine, oak and cedar forest above Julian; snow most winters. RVs and trailers use sites 1-60; sites 62-103 are tent-only. Only sites 1-20 take 40 ft, and the rest are 20-30 ft, so check the site's own length. Coin-operated showers. --Claude
summary: William Heise: year-round county park, $36 non-hookup / $39 partial hookup (20/30/50A + water at 1-40) + $8 reservation fee, county engine parksres.sandiegocounty.gov (1-year window, 14-night max). RV sites 1-60 (20-40 ft); 62-103 tent-only. Not waterfront (no water). Pin 126 m from the RV-site centroid, fine. Phone empty -> (760) 765-0650.
